svg.aria-label: The TL crates. tl-syntax defines the formula graph, profiles and signal catalog, and tl-parse, tl-oracle, tl-mltl, tl-rewrite and filament-mltl all depend on it. tl-rewrite depends on tl-mltl. filament-mltl depends on tl-mltl and filament-observation, and is the single bridge to Filament. Dashed lines are development-only: tl-mltl and tl-rewrite test against tl-oracle, and tl-rewrite tests against tl-parse.
